 Grants & Scholarships
 Scholarships from the Community Foundation
 For Students in Northern Virginia and Beyond
 Scholarships Open
The Community Foundation for Northern Virginia manages 35 scholarship funds that support Northern Virginia students pursuing undergraduate and graduate degrees. Each year, the Community Foundation awards over $500,000 in scholarship funds to nearly 150 students.
Volunteer committees review and make scholarship award recommendations for the scholarships managed by the Community Foundation.
 Donate
Many of the Scholarship Funds held at the Community Foundation accept donations. Scroll through the list below for more information on each and to make a donation.
 Donate 
 Open a Scholarship Fund
Interested in supporting students' education? The Community Foundation has prepared a Scholarship Fund Handbook as a resource for current and prospective fund advisors, designed to provide helpful and transparent information for you and your family. See below, and learn more about how to open a fund at the Community Foundation.

 Booz Allen Hamilton Vision Scholarship Fund
 Supports five scholarships per year for four years for legal dependents of Booz Allen Hamilton employees from anywhere around the world. Awards are based on demonstrated superior academic achievement, character, and citizenship activities.

SLHS students who qualify are eligible to apply for tuition support for their Dual Enrollment with SHLS and JMU, in order to earn college credit while they are high school students.
